props.name: orientation
props.description: Set on Stepper.Root. Layout axis. Default 'vertical'. 'horizontal' is scoped to a flat list of top-level Steps — StepGroup/nested Steps assume vertical trunk-and-branch geometry (see stepper-group.tsx's DOM-measured connector math) and are not supported in horizontal mode. See README.md.

props.name: disableCompletedFade
props.description: Set on Stepper.Root. When true, completed steps stay at full opacity with no hover/focus restore. Omit or false keeps the default 0.6 mute. UUI-3726.

props.name: collapsibleNestedSteps
props.description: Set on Stepper.Root. When true, nested steps with panel content show a collapse chevron (SinglePaneStepper).
